warning: Evidence only; not executable migration SQL. Review these defaults carefully before any fresh-install baseline is accepted.
important_observations: Default privileges for newly created public-schema tables owned by postgres grant ALL table privileges (arwdDxtm) to anon, authenticated, and service_role. RLS remains a separate row-level control and must be enabled and correctly configured on every exposed table.

Default privileges for newly created public-schema functions owned by postgres grant EXECUTE to anon, authenticated, and service_role. Every SECURITY DEFINER function must be reviewed individually and should not inherit broad execution access without a documented reason.
Default privileges are also present for objects created by supabase_admin; treat platform-owned defaults separately from application-owned baseline DDL.
The three observed sequences grant USAGE to anon, authenticated, and service_role. Verify whether this is required by the app before reproducing.
Do not blindly copy these defaults into the reconstructed baseline. Confirm which defaults are intentional and which should be tightened in a separately reviewed security change.
